# Shikkha24

> শিক্ষা২৪ — Bangladesh's Bengali-only education news portal. Latest education news, scholarship deadlines, exam routines, results, institution directory, study-abroad guides, and job circulars.

Shikkha24 (shikkha24.com) is a Bengali-language education news portal covering all levels of education in Bangladesh: primary, secondary, higher secondary, undergraduate, and postgraduate. The site publishes 15-20 articles per day with burst capacity of 40+ on result days and admission seasons. Content is editorially curated by a 5-person newsroom.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://shikkha24.com/): Latest education news, breaking ticker, deadline strip
- [Latest news](https://shikkha24.com/latest): Full chronological feed of all published articles
- [Scholarships](https://shikkha24.com/scholarships): Deadline-sorted scholarship tracker (domestic and international)
- [Deadlines](https://shikkha24.com/deadlines): Academic calendar — admission, exam, result, and scholarship deadlines with type/level/district filters
- [Results](https://shikkha24.com/results): Results and merit lists hub with links to official portals and how-to guides
- [Institutions](https://shikkha24.com/institutions): University and college directory with admission info and addresses
- [Exams](https://shikkha24.com/exams): Exam routines and syllabus, sorted by date
- [Circulars](https://shikkha24.com/circulars): Education and BCS/job circular tracker
- [Study abroad](https://shikkha24.com/study-abroad): Country guides for studying abroad — costs, visas, scholarships

## Categories

- [Admission](https://shikkha24.com/category/admission): ভর্তি সংবাদ
- [Results](https://shikkha24.com/category/results): ফলাফল সংবাদ
- [Scholarship](https://shikkha24.com/category/scholarship): বৃত্তি সংবাদ
- [Exam](https://shikkha24.com/category/exam): পরীক্ষা সংবাদ
- [Circular](https://shikkha24.com/category/circular): নিয়োগ বিজ্ঞপ্তি
- [Study abroad](https://shikkha24.com/category/study-abroad): বিদেশে পড়াশোনা
- [Education news](https://shikkha24.com/category/education-news): শিক্ষা সংবাদ
- [Teacher news](https://shikkha24.com/category/teacher): শিক্ষক সংবাদ

## Tools

- [GPA calculator](https://shikkha24.com/gpa): SSC/HSC GPA calculator (client-side, no backend)
- [Search](https://shikkha24.com/search): Full-text search across all articles
- [Bookmarks](https://shikkha24.com/bookmarks): Save articles and deadlines (browser-local, no account needed)

## Feeds

- [RSS](https://shikkha24.com/rss.xml): All articles
- [Sitemap](https://shikkha24.com/sitemap.xml): All URLs
- [News sitemap](https://shikkha24.com/news-sitemap.xml): Articles published in the last 48 hours

## About

- Language: Bengali (bn-BD)
- Publisher: Shikkha24
- Content is free and accessible to all readers
- All content is original reporting or editorially curated from official sources
